segment.source:
::The guard motions you to stop before speaking in a rigid, official tone of voice.::
Excuse me, $(#sir/ma'am), but I must advise you to stay on this side of the bridge. It is unsafe to go across, and, as you can see, Praetorian Security enforcers have been posted here to make sure nothing unwanted gets in the city.<end>

segment.source: They aren't, it's just that we still haven't received orders to return to headquarters. Even though the Faceless have retreated, we still need to be on alert. That's my take on it.<end>

segment.source: Oh, didn't recognize you. Must be new. There's muties across the bridge, but we're more afraid of the Faceless. Take extreme care if you've been sent there.<end>
